title: Biased draw overshoots the group radius on diagonal directions — the 'candidate JOINS the estate' claim fails for dist >= 4 diagonal draws
evidence:
dir := growth_dir_pick(rng)
				lo := GROWTH_MIN_SEP_TILES
				hi := cat.balance.growth_groups.radius_tiles
				if lo > hi {
					lo = hi // degenerate guard — the loader already pins radius > sep
				}
				dist := rng_range(rng, lo, hi)
				pos = t.node_pos[anchor_slot] + dir * dist
... vs the view's Euclidean adjacency (core/growth.odin:185-187):
			d := t.node_pos[a] - t.node_pos[b]
			if i64(d[0])*i64(d[0]) + i64(d[1])*i64(d[1]) <= r2 {
... and the doc claim (core/growth.odin:486): "	//    member of that cluster (within radius_tiles — the candidate JOINS the"
detail: Diagonal dirs ({1,1} etc.) with dist 4–5 place the candidate at Euclidean dist×sqrt(2) = 5.7–7.1 tiles from the anchor — outside radius_tiles=5, so it does not join the estate in the derived view as documented. Still E31-safe and deterministic; only the bias is weaker than stated.
recommended_fix: For diagonal dirs clamp dist to radius_tiles*7/10 (integer floor of r/sqrt(2)), or update the comment/PR body to state diagonal draws may land outside the anchor's radius.

title: growth_groups parsed with jint (silent decimal truncation) instead of the jint_strict bar the 5.9 sibling adopted for new state-affecting tunables
evidence:
b.growth_groups.bias_prob_permille = jint(gobj, "bias_prob_permille", -1)
			b.growth_groups.min_members = jint(gobj, "min_members", -1)
			b.growth_groups.max_members = jint(gobj, "max_members", -1)
			b.growth_groups.radius_tiles = jint(gobj, "radius_tiles", -1)
			b.growth_groups.member_weight_permille = jint(gobj, "member_weight_permille", -1)
... vs jint (core/catalog.odin:1128-1135): "case json.Float:   return i32(x)" — silent truncation; and the 5.9 sibling (core/catalog.odin:771-774): "JINT_STRICT (the new-catalog integer bar, ODN-10): a decimal/wrong-typed fraction is a load rejection, never a silent truncation ... b.cap_fraction_permille, _ = jint_strict(obj, "cap_fraction_permille", -1)"
detail: A decimal like bias_prob_permille 750.5 silently truncates to 750 instead of failing load, against the ODN-10 integer-only bar the immediately-preceding 5.9 cap_fraction field explicitly hardened. Matches the older warnings-block convention, so impact is convention drift, not a live bug.
recommended_fix: Switch the five growth_groups reads to jint_strict and reject on !ok, mirroring cap_fraction_permille; add a decimal row per key in test_catalogs_load_failfast.
